section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1988
title: large variation in the volume of accidental deaths in the different States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities, the difference in topography, density of population, density of traffic and level of industrialisation appear to have contributed to the phenomenon. 1.2.3. Among the States, Goa reported the highest volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population (50.9) and the Manipur the lowest (5.8). Among the Union Territories, the highest volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was recorded in Pondicherry (58.5), while the lowest in Lakshadweep (6.7). Among the Metropolitan Cities, the highest volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was registered in Bombay (82.1) and the lowest (7.5) in Pune. 1.2.4.
